title: Stage a layered OBJ runtime owner
changes: Prepare a test-only typed runtime owner for layered OBJ descriptor, sequence and list reads, preserving prior-owner and raw-gap composition.
validation: The focused Wine test poisons all 633 source spans and verifies all 20,474 typed bytes, four-byte boundary/prior-owner composition, all 566 host-list lookups and a rejected source-binding edit. Evidence: target/validation/units/e130-layered-obj-staged-build-_4ml_mrq/ and e130-layered-obj-staged-wine-o8ryattt/. Protected inputs passed and successful scratch was removed.
limitations: The owner remains compiled only for tests and is not attached to extraction, runtime or CLI. Native reads, lifecycle and ordinary use remain unverified; Linux, USA and native Windows are separate. No performance measurement.
